note: A template, not a map: the placeholders name roles, never models, because model ids go stale and the validator refuses vendor ids in what ships. A host writes ~/.config/task-pipeline/judge-models.json (or points $TASK_PIPELINE_JUDGE_MODELS at its file) from its own model map; the estate's model owner edits that file like any other change. spec_judge.py never calls a placeholder. rank 1 is the strongest; the tool takes the strongest entry whose family differs from the spec's author_family, else the strongest of the same family, recorded as judged-degraded.

models.model: <the map's strongest model of vendor A>
<the map's strongest model of vendor B>
<the map's strongest model of vendor C>
